decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered out several products that were merely accessories (cases, charging cables) to focus on actual speakers. My consideration set included a range of price points: the premium Harman Kardon Onyx Studio 6, the high-end aesthetic JBL Pulse 4, the mid-range Ortizan, the budget-friendly EDUPLINK, and the utility-focused ZEALOT. The Harman Kardon Onyx Studio 6 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_116) was ultimately selected because it holds the highest rating (4.7) among the primary speakers and received specific praise for its 'crisp clear music with a ton of thump,' suggesting it offers the best audio performance for its $159.99 price. Although the EDUPLINK offered impressive value, the superior audio quality and brand reputation of Harman Kardon made it the final choice for a serious listener.
